# FLOPS Index — Public Reference (anon)
#
# Surface:     /llms-full.txt
# Version:     anon-v1 (2026-05-29 regen)
# Companion:   /llms.txt (summary), /openapi.json (machine spec),
#              /.well-known/ai-plugin.json, /ai.txt
# Spec:        https://github.com/zeroatflops/flopsindex/tree/main/schema
#
# Source-opaque GPU compute price indices with
# citation and verify URLs. This document describes ONLY the public,
# unauthenticated surface of app.flopsindex.com. Every published value
# is identified by index_id and carries a verify_url an agent (or
# downstream auditor) can use to confirm the cited number against the
# latest published tick.

# =====================================================================
# What this surface is
# =====================================================================
#
# The anonymous public surface of app.flopsindex.com publishes a
# single, delayed, globally rolled-up reference value per published
# index. The value is delayed onto a real ~6-hour grid: as_of snaps
# to 00/06/12/18 UTC. Six endpoints, one 14-field envelope, no
# methodology internals, no source attribution, no regional
# decomposition, no dispersion bands, no forecasts, no derivative-grade
# dispatch tools. Public values are INDICATIVE reference only —
# NOT FOR SETTLEMENT.
#
# Anonymous callers are welcome — quoting FLOPS reference rates in a
# chatbot or report is free. For real-time precision, broader index
# families, or programmatic dispatch, mint an API key (agent-grade
# keys available) or contact team@flopsindex.com.
#
# Canonical idiom: price -> verify -> cite.
#   1. GET /v1/price/{INDEX_ID}                    — read the value
#   2. GET /v1/verify?index_id={id}&value={value}  — confirm provenance
#   3. Cite https://app.flopsindex.com/i/{INDEX_ID} — link the source

# =====================================================================
# Endpoints (the 6 anon paths)
# =====================================================================
#
# These are the ONLY paths reachable without an API key. Any other
# path on app.flopsindex.com returns 401 for an anonymous caller; a
# 404 returns the constant body `{"detail":"Not Found"}` with no
# schema hints or taxonomy enumeration.
#
# * GET /healthz
#     Liveness probe. Returns 200 + `{"status":"ok"}`.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/healthz
#
# * GET /readyz
#     Readiness probe (catalog + oracle reachable). Returns 200 +
#     `{"status":"ready"}` when the public surface can answer.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/readyz
#
# * GET /v1/price/{slug}
#     Latest published value for one index. Returns the 14-field
#     envelope described below. Anonymous response is delayed to a
#     ~6h grid (as_of snaps to 00/06/12/18 UTC) and value is rounded
#     to 2 decimals.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/v1/price/FLOPS-H100-SPOT
#
# * GET /v1/price/{slug}.txt
#     Plain-text one-liner, agent-pasteable, for the same latest
#     published value. One line, no JSON wrapping.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/v1/price/FLOPS-H100-OD.txt
#
# * GET /v1/search?q={query}&limit={n}
#     Free-text query resolved to canonical index slugs from the
#     public catalog. Auth-free. Returns slug list with display names.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/v1/search?q=H100+spot
#
# * GET /v1/verify?index_id={id}&value={value}&ts={iso8601}
#     Verify a cited value against the latest published tick.
#     Returns verification status, the canonical value, and citation
#     metadata. Use to confirm an agent-quoted number before it ships.
#     Example: https://app.flopsindex.com/v1/verify?index_id=FLOPS-H100-SPOT&value=2.95

# =====================================================================
# Index families on the anon surface
# =====================================================================
#
# The FLOPS family is the ONLY family published on the anonymous
# surface. Discover specific slugs through /v1/search or
# /v2/catalog/public.
#
# * FLOPS-{model}-{OD|SPOT|DEPIN}
#     GPU compute price indices. OD = on-demand reservation. SPOT =
#     interruptible/spot. DEPIN = decentralized physical infrastructure
#     marketplaces.
#
#     The family spans many accelerator models — NVIDIA data-center and
#     workstation GPUs plus AMD Instinct — not just H100. Representative
#     slugs (the live set is larger and changes as coverage crosses the
#     source floor; ALWAYS read /v2/catalog/public for the current list):
#       - FLOPS-H100-OD        (H100, on-demand)
#       - FLOPS-H100-SPOT      (H100, spot)
#       - FLOPS-H100-DEPIN     (H100, decentralized)
#       - FLOPS-A100-SPOT      (A100)
#       - FLOPS-H200-OD        (H200)
#       - FLOPS-B200-OD        (B200 / Blackwell)
#       - FLOPS-L40S-OD        (L40S)
#       - FLOPS-RTX4090-DEPIN  (RTX 4090)
#       - FLOPS-MI300X-OD      (AMD Instinct MI300X)
#
#     A model+shape publishes on the anon surface only once it clears the
#     >=3-independent-source floor (k-anonymity); thinner coverage is
#     withheld until it qualifies. So the catalog grows over time — treat
#     /v2/catalog/public as the source of truth, never a hardcoded list.
#
# Other slug families exist on the platform but are entitled-only and
# do NOT appear on the anonymous surface. They are not enumerated
# here by design; keyed callers receive them through their own
# entitled catalog.

# =====================================================================
# Envelope shape (the 14-field anon response)
# =====================================================================
#
# /v1/price/{slug} returns exactly these 14 fields for an anonymous
# caller. No other fields are returned on the anon surface.
#
#   index_id        string   — canonical slug (uppercase)
#   value           number   — latest published value, rounded to 2 decimals
#   unit            string   — "USD/GPU-hr"
#   as_of           string   — RFC3339 UTC timestamp; snapped to the
#                              ~6h grid (00/06/12/18 UTC)
#   delayed         boolean  — always true on the anon surface
#   data_tier       string   — data tier on the public surface (e.g. "LIVE")
#   confidence      string   — "HIGH" or "MED" (label only; no numeric weight)
#   change_24h      string   — banded 24h direction: "UP" | "FLAT" | "DOWN"
#   disclaimer      string   — indicative reference; not for settlement
#   methodology_url string   — absolute URL to the public methodology page
#                              (/i/{INDEX_ID}/methodology)
#   verify_url      string   — absolute URL to /v1/verify for this value
#   citation_url    string   — absolute URL to the index citation page
#   permalink       string   — stable permalink to the index page
#   upgrade         string   — pointer to keyed/partner access
#
# These 14 fields are the entire anon response. The surface is
# source-opaque by contract: it carries no source identities, no
# per-source detail, and nothing describing how the value is produced.

# =====================================================================
# Citation pattern
# =====================================================================
#
# Agents cite the value + verify_url; never a source set; never a
# per-provider price; never a panel composition. The citation_url
# resolves to a permalink page with schema.org JSON-LD an LLM or
# downstream system can parse.
#
# Worked example, idiomatic LLM citation:
#
#   "The H100 spot rate is $2.95 per GPU-hour as of
#    2026-05-29T14:00:00Z (FLOPS-H100-SPOT, delayed reference).
#    Verifiable at https://app.flopsindex.com/v1/verify?index_id=FLOPS-H100-SPOT&value=2.95
#    Source: https://app.flopsindex.com/i/FLOPS-H100-SPOT"
#
# Citation format (Chicago-style):
#
#   Project FLOPS, Inc. (2026). {index_name}. FLOPS Reference Index
#   (delayed). https://app.flopsindex.com/i/{index_id}

# =====================================================================
# Rate limits + access paths
# =====================================================================
#
# Anonymous: 60 requests per minute and 2,000 requests per day per
# caller (counted per-machine; fail-closed on breach). These are the
# defaults; rate-limited responses return 429 + Retry-After.
#
# Keyed access (X-FLOPS-Api-Key header) lifts the ~6h delay, restores
# real-time full precision on the value, and unlocks additional
# entitled index families. Mint an agent-grade key at
# https://flopsindex.com .
#
# Programmatic surfaces (all read the same anon envelope without a key):
#   - Hosted MCP: https://app.flopsindex.com/mcp (5 tools)
#   - PyPI:       pip install flopsindex            (REST SDK)
#   - PyPI:       pip install flopsindex-mcp        (stdio MCP server)
#   - npm:        npm install @flopsindex/sdk       (JS/TS SDK)

# =====================================================================
# What this surface contains
# =====================================================================
#
# The anonymous surface is source-opaque by contract. It publishes the
# public envelope above — a single delayed global reference value per
# index, with citation and verify URLs — and nothing about how that
# value is produced: no methodology internals, no source identities,
# no per-source detail.
#
# Higher-fidelity access (real-time precision, broader coverage,
# additional index families) is available to keyed callers and
# partners. The anonymous document does not describe those capabilities
# or enumerate what it withholds.
